findings.title: Drupal Core SA-CORE-2026-004 / CVE-2026-9082 — PostgreSQL SQL Injection Patches Shipped 2026-05-20 (Highly Critical, NIST 20/25)
findings.affected_technology: Drupal core database abstraction API on PostgreSQL backend (11.3.x / 11.2.x / 11.1.x / 10.6.x / 10.5.x / 10.4.x and EOL 8.9 / 9.5 via manual patches)
findings.summary: Drupal SA-CORE-2026-004 patches shipped on schedule 2026-05-20 17:00-21:00 UTC; CVE-2026-9082 assigned and confirmed as anonymous SQL injection in the database abstraction API on PostgreSQL backend with potential RCE, mass-exploitation window opens within 24-72h per historical Drupalgeddon pattern.

findings.title: GitHub Confirms 3,800+ Internal Repositories Exfiltrated via Poisoned VS Code Extension — TeamPCP Attribution Includes Copilot, CodeQL, Actions, Dependabot Internals
findings.affected_technology: GitHub internal SDLC + VS Code marketplace ecosystem
findings.summary: GitHub confirmed TeamPCP exfiltrated ~3,800-4,000 internal repositories via a single employee installing a poisoned VS Code extension; leaked corpus listed for sale at $50K and includes Copilot internals, CodeQL, Dependabot, Actions, Codespaces, internal infrastructure code.

findings.title: DNS Server Coordinated Patches 2026-05-20 — Unbound 11-CVE Batch (CVE-2026-33278 Critical RCE in DNSSEC Validation) + BIND 9 6-CVE Batch (CVE-2026-3593 DoH Heap-UAF → RCE)
findings.affected_technology: NLnet Labs Unbound (recursive resolver) + ISC BIND 9 (authoritative + recursive); fixed in Unbound 1.25.1, BIND 9.18.49 / 9.20.23 / 9.21.22
findings.summary: Same-day coordinated patches across two of three most-deployed open-source DNS servers; Unbound CVE-2026-33278 is a critical RCE reachable during normal DNSSEC validation, BIND CVE-2026-3593 is a DoH heap-UAF with RCE class impact, plus 9+ lower-severity DoS / cache poisoning issues across both.

findings.title: authentik CVE-2026-40165 — SAML NameID XML Comment Injection Authentication Bypass (CVSS 8.7)
findings.affected_technology: authentik IdP — versions prior to 2025.12.5 (LTS) and 2026.2.3 (current)
findings.summary: Widely deployed open-source IdP authentik suffers SAML NameID XML comment injection allowing authentication bypass / user impersonation; classic OneLogin-2018-class bug re-emerges in newer SAML stack and cascades into every downstream SSO-protected application.

findings.title: Microsoft DCU 'Fox Tempest' MSaaS Takedown Expands — 4 New Ransomware Affiliates (INC, Qilin, BlackByte, Akira) + 3 Malware Families (Oyster, Lumma, Vidar)
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft Artifact Signing (abused by attacker MSaaS) + downstream Authenticode trust
findings.summary: Microsoft expanded Fox Tempest MSaaS attribution today — adds INC / Qilin / BlackByte / Akira as ransomware affiliates and Oyster / Lumma / Vidar as malware families distributed via the signed-binary service, widening the retroactive-hunt aperture for revoked-cert thumbprints.

findings.title: SonicWall Gen6 SSL-VPN CVE-2024-12802 MFA Bypass — Active Ransomware Exploitation Feb-Mar 2026 Confirmed by ReliaQuest (Incomplete-Patch + Gen6 EOL Convergence)
findings.affected_technology: SonicWall Gen6 SSL-VPN (EOL 2026-04-16); Gen7 / Gen8 require firmware update only
findings.summary: ReliaQuest writeup confirms active ransomware exploitation Feb-Mar 2026 of CVE-2024-12802 MFA bypass on SonicWall Gen6 SSL-VPN — incomplete patch where admins must also delete and recreate LDAP config without userPrincipalName; Gen6 EOL leaves many sites with the surface live.

findings.title: EvilTokens OAuth Consent Phishing-as-a-Service — 340+ Microsoft 365 Organizations Compromised in 5 Weeks via Legitimate Device-Code Consent Flow
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft 365 OAuth device-code consent flow + downstream Mail/Drive/Calendar/Contacts API surface
findings.summary: EvilTokens phishing-as-a-service compromised 340+ M365 orgs across 5 countries in 5 weeks by abusing legitimate OAuth device-code consent — victim completes real MFA then clicks Accept on a consent screen, attacker receives refresh tokens scoped to mailbox/drive/calendar/contacts.

findings.title: Anthropic Claude Code SOCKS5 Null-Byte Injection Sandbox Bypass — Silently Patched 2026-03-31, Disclosed 2026-05-20 (No CVE Assigned by Vendor)
findings.affected_technology: Anthropic Claude Code CLI agent — versions prior to 2.1.88 (active surface Oct 2025 to 2026-03-31)
findings.summary: Claude Code's outbound network allowlist could be bypassed via SOCKS5 hostname null-byte injection (attacker-host.com\x00.google.com) — chainable with prompt injection ('Comment and Control') for env / credential exfiltration; Anthropic patched silently in 2.1.88 and declined to assign a CVE.

findings.title: rsync 3.4.3 — 6-CVE Batch Including CVE-2026-43618 (CVSS 8.1) Authenticated-User Memory Disclosure + CVE-2026-29518 (CVSS 7.3) Daemon TOCTOU Privilege Escalation
findings.affected_technology: rsync 3.4.2 and earlier (daemon + client); fixed in 3.4.3
findings.summary: rsync 3.4.3 fixes 6 CVEs including authenticated remote memory disclosure via compressed-token decoder integer overflow (CVE-2026-43618 CVSS 8.1) and daemon-mode TOCTOU symlink-race privilege escalation when use_chroot=no (CVE-2026-29518 CVSS 7.3).

findings.title: CVE-2026-24425 Twig Sandbox Bypass → Full RCE (CVSS 8.8) — Affects All Twig 2.16.x and 3.9.0-3.25.x
findings.affected_technology: Twig PHP templating engine (used by Drupal, Symfony, Craft CMS, eZ Platform, multi-tenant PHP SaaS)
findings.summary: Twig SourcePolicyInterface-based sandbox is bypassable by passing arbitrary PHP callables into sort/filter/map/reduce filters, yielding full RCE in the web process; primary risk surface is multi-tenant PHP platforms where users can submit Twig fragments — fixed in 3.26.0.
